course.title: Engineering Alloys and Materials Selection
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Select a suitable material with appropriate reasoning(s) for spring applications from the (20) following Titanium-based materials:
(i) Grade 2, (ii) Grade II, (iii) Ti-3Al-2.5V, (iv) Ti-6Al-4V and (v) Ti-3A1-8V-6Cr-4Mn-4Zr.
The selected materials must fulfill the following criterions:
\* Must have good forming and shaping characteristics
\* Must have good resistance to hydrogen embrittlement

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
